evidence.description: src/App.test.tsx "shows an empty 'Search' input in the controls with the other filters (SDLC-13 AC1)" and "reaches the Search input with Tab and types into it (SDLC-13 AC1)" passed. The e2e test "searches tasks by title combined with other filters" was written but not run locally.

src/domain/filter.test.ts matchesSearch tests (empty, whitespace-only, ignores case, trims surrounding spaces, internal spaces literal, regex characters as plain text) and filterTasks "filters by title search ignoring case" / "returns every title containing the search" passed, as did src/App.test.tsx "filters the list by title as the user types, ignoring case and surrounding spaces (SDLC-13 AC2)".
src/domain/filter.test.ts "combines search with status and starredOnly" and src/App.test.tsx "combines Search with Status and Starred only, keeping each filter's value (SDLC-13 AC3)" passed.
src/App.test.tsx "counts only the tasks the search leaves visible (SDLC-13 AC4)" passed. It asserts "Showing 1 of 12 tasks · 1 starred" in the aria-live="polite" paragraph.
src/App.test.tsx "shows the existing empty-state message when the search matches nothing (SDLC-13 AC5)" passed.
src/App.test.tsx "shows the tasks again when the search is cleared or left with only spaces (SDLC-13 AC6)" passed.

reason: Implemented title search as planned. TaskQuery in src/domain/filter.ts now has a required `search` field and a pure exported `matchesSearch(title, search)` (trimmed, lowercased, substring match with String.includes) that filterTasks ANDs with the status and starred filters. App holds the search in memory and renders a labelled `<input id="search-filter" type="search">` as the last control in the existing controls row; the count line and empty state are unchanged and derive from the same filtered list. Added unit tests (matchesSearch, filterTasks with search), component tests for SDLC-13 AC1–AC6 and a new Playwright journey test. The only change to existing tests is adding `search: ""` to their TaskQuery literals (some lines were rewrapped), with no assertion changes. There were no feedback items or notes for this run.
